Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W · L9637D K-Line Transceiver · Waveshare 7" 1024x600 HDMI · DS2 over ISO 9141

g.text: BMW E36: under dashboard, driver side
K-Line on Pin 7 connects to MS41 DME
100nF ceramic cap between VCC (pin 7) and GND (pin 2)
Pins 5+6 connect together to OBD Pin 7 (K-Line)
3.3V logic on TX/RX ↔ 12V on K-Line bus
Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W — GPIO Header (J8)
← 5V from LM2596 buck converter (via μUSB or header)
← Common ground with L9637D and OBD-II
Adjust trimpot to 5.0V output before connecting!
Motronic DME · M52 Engine · BMW E36/E39
Baud: 9600, 8 data, Even parity, 1 stop bit

svg.text: 5V to Pi (via header pin 2/4 or μUSB)
Common Ground Bus (OBD Pin 4/5 → Buck GND → L9637D GND → Pi GND)

g.text: Baud: 9600 | Data: 8 bit | Parity: Even | Stop: 1
PL011 UART on GPIO14/15; BT moved to miniUART
Display backlight: via separate 5V or HDMI power
